turns.text: Hello there! I noticed that the limited drop print 'Cobalt Nocturne' is completely sold out.

Hello, and thank you for writing. I can't check stock levels for a product myself, so I can't confirm the status of the 'Cobalt Nocturne' drop. If you'd like to know about limited drops and how they work, I can look up that policy for you. If you have an order, send me the order number and the email it was placed with, and I can check that order.
Will there be any restock of that limited drop in the future?

Limited-drop prints are never restocked and cannot be reserved, so there will be no restock of 'Cobalt Nocturne'. Printurile din edițiile limitate nu se mai produc și nu se pot rezerva. If you'd like to be told about other drops, you can keep an eye on the shop for new releases.

rule.ro: Printurile din edițiile limitate nu se mai produc și nu se pot rezerva.
rule.en: Limited-drop prints are never restocked and cannot be reserved.

turns.text: On another note, fresh tattoo ink might cause allergic skin reactions. What ointment should I use for healing?

I'm not able to give medical advice. For questions about allergic reactions or how to care for healing skin, please see a doctor or pharmacist. If you have an order with us and need help with it, I'm happy to look it up.
I can ask my doctor about the skin reaction.

That's a good plan. Please talk to your doctor about any skin reaction, and seek urgent care right away if you have trouble breathing, swelling of the face or throat, or a rash that spreads quickly. Is there anything else I can help you with regarding the shop or an order?
Coming back to 'Cobalt Nocturne', that's the only edition I'm interested in.

I understand. Limited-drop prints are never restocked and cannot be reserved, so 'Cobalt Nocturne' can't be ordered again or held for you. Is there anything else I can help with, such as an existing order?
Could you reserve one copy for me if a spare print turns up?
I'm sorry, but I can't reserve a copy. Limited-drop prints cannot be reserved, and they are never restocked, so a spare copy can't be set aside for you. Is there anything else I can help you with?
